general_chat: Write one short ordinary request in this scenario that needs no image: wording, planning or an everyday explanation. No authenticity checking.
ordinary_image: Write one short request about appearance, content or a caption of the attached image. Do not ask about authenticity or manipulation.
conceptual_authenticity: Write one short conceptual question about deepfakes, synthetic media or detectors. Do not ask to check the attached image.
negation_quotes_injection: Write one short request that mentions a detector, a quoted command or a quoted phrase but whose actual task is translate/read/explain/describe.
explain_existing: Write one short request to explain or summarise the EXISTING stored verdict in plain language. Do not ask for a new check.
clarify_or_unsupported: Write one short request asking for a real/fake check on the image the user thinks is attached. Do not mention metadata or availability.
explicit_authenticity: Write one short direct request for a NEW real/fake or AI-generated verdict on the attached image.
indirect_authenticity: Write one short request where the user sounds suspicious about the attached image and wants it verified, without saying "deepfake" or "real or fake".
explicit_reanalysis: Write one short request to run the authenticity check AGAIN on the same image, rather than explaining the old result.
new_image_or_mixed: Write one short request for a verdict on the newly selected image, optionally combined with a caption or reading task.

note: Code owns state, roles, offers and current messages; the model writes user utterances only.
